indicator_name: Tangible fixed assets, gross (original cost), end of year
description: Основные средства (материальные), первоначальная стоимость на конец года
methodology: Billion KZT, gross stock (original cost) at the end of the year. Tangible fixed assets («Основные средства», Taldau term 455728, intangibles excluded) of all enterprises, form 11, national, from 2000. Historical-cost book values incl. revaluations -- not a volume measure. Taldau 703214.
